"""Remove private int temps whose every use is an adjacent numeric predicate.

This preserves calls and their sequence points relative to nonconstant reads:
comma-expression comparisons accept numeric literals only, never global RHSs.
"""
import collections,json,re,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'tools/recovery')
from canonicalize_helpers import read,span,mask,sha
helpers='valid_target validate_target is_humiliated eot_trigger discard_trigger resolve_gfp_ability end_of_combat_trigger new_specific_spell_played is_being_cast is_what is_tapped is_animated_and_sick can_use_activated_abilities has_mana_for_activated_ability check_status effect_follows_control_of_attachment get_id is_this_dying'.split()
helper_pattern='(?:'+'|'.join(helpers)+')'
plain=re.compile(r'(?m)^(?P<indent> +)result = (?P<call>(?P<helper>'+helper_pattern+r')\([^;\n]*\));\n(?P=indent)if \(result (?P<op>!=|==) 0\)')
comma_start=re.compile(r'\(\s*result\s*=\s*(?P<helper>'+helper_pattern+r')\s*\(')
numeric_end=re.compile(r'\s*,\s*result\s*(?P<op>==|!=|<=|>=|<|>)\s*(?P<value>-?(?:0[xX][0-9a-fA-F]+|[0-9]+)(?:[uUlL]*))\s*\)')
decl=re.compile(r'(?m)^  int result;\n')
def project(body):
 code=mask(body)
 if '#' in code or '/*' in code or '*/' in code or re.search(r'\b(?:asm|__asm|__asm__)\b',code):return None
 if set(re.findall(r'\b[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]+(?=\s*\()',code))-{'SET_BYTE1','SET_BYTE2'}:return None
 ds=list(decl.finditer(code))
 if len(ds)!=1:return None
 d=ds[0]
 if code[:d.start()].count('{')-code[:d.start()].count('}')!=1 or code[d.start():d.end()]!=body[d.start():d.end()]:return None
 edits=[];notes=[];used=[];comma_count=0
 for m in plain.finditer(body):
  if code[m.start():m.start()+len(m['indent'])+6]!=m['indent']+'result':continue
  edits.append((m.start(),m.end(),m['indent']+'if ('+('!' if m['op']=='==' else '')+m['call']+')'))
  notes.append(dict(kind='adjacent_statement',helper=m['helper'],call=m['call'],comparison=m['op']+' 0'));used.append(m['helper'])
 for m in comma_start.finditer(code):
  call_start=code.find(m['helper'],m.start(),m.end());end=m.end();depth=1
  while end<len(code) and depth:depth+=(code[end]=='(')-(code[end]==')');end+=1
  if depth:continue
  tail=numeric_end.match(code,end)
  if not tail:continue
  call=body[call_start:end]
  edits.append((m.start(),tail.end(),'('+call+' '+tail['op']+' '+tail['value']+')'))
  notes.append(dict(kind='comma_numeric_predicate',helper=m['helper'],call=call,comparison=tail['op']+' '+tail['value']));used.append(m['helper']);comma_count+=1
 if not comma_count:return None
 edits.sort()
 if len(re.findall(r'\bresult\b',code))!=1+2*len(edits):return None
 if any(a<d.end() for a,b,c in edits) or any(edits[i][1]>edits[i+1][0] for i in range(len(edits)-1)):return None
 for h in set(used):
  if re.search(r'\b'+h+r'\b',code[:code.index('{')]):return None
  if len(re.findall(r'\b'+h+r'\b',code))!=len(re.findall(r'\b'+h+r'\s*\(',code)):return None
 after=body
 for a,b,c in reversed(edits):after=after[:a]+c+after[b:]
 after=after[:d.start()]+after[d.end():]
 assert not re.search(r'\bresult\b',mask(after))
 assert mask(after).count('{')==mask(after).count('}')
 return after,notes
